summary: BrenX Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of a Special General Meeting of Shareholders held November 6, 2026. The meeting lacked quorum at 12:00 p.m. Israel time, was adjourned, reconvened at 1:00 p.m. with quorum present, and shareholders approved the sole agenda item detailed in the October 20, 2026 notice and proxy statement. No terms, prices, stakes, board recommendations or advisors were disclosed. This is a routine meeting-result filing, not a special situation; no deal or structural angle to watch.
